docs.description: Open when present: the server's word. Adding or removing the attribute wins, also after show() or a close; identical markup keeps the local state. Emits no sb-open or sb-close. isOpen tells whether it is showing. open="false" reads as closed but is deprecated: leave the attribute out.
Render in place, always visible, without an overlay or close button (previews, docs).
Show the close button (not on inline panels). On by default: closable="false" turns it off.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Action buttons. Elements with data-sb-close close the dialog; sb-close reports the attribute's value (or the element's text) as detail.value.

events.name: sb-open
events.description: After show() opened it (not when the server opens it).

events.name: sb-close
events.description: After the user or close() closed it (not when the server closes it). detail: { reason: button | escape | backdrop | action | api, value }.
